Why do we accept candidates running unopposed?

I think the best way would be to redistrict in a non-partisan fashion. The usual reason (though certainly not the only one) for candidates running unopposed is because their district was Gerrymandered to virtually guarantee a seat for them every time. By eliminating Gerrymandering you would dramatically increase the number of districts which are contestable in any given election.

Unfortunately that doesn't help at all with local politics because it's much easier to become entrenched by virtue of name recognition/incumbency.

In those cases something that -might- help, or might not, is to remove party affiliation and incumbency markings from the final ballot. If people want to vote along party lines, then at least force them to do some research beforehand, or let them randomly choose a candidate.
